title: Minimalist header — what rises out of the wallpaper?

steps.path: Top row of the window, in Meadow Mist
steps.headline: Which individual button feels like it's rising through the wallpaper?
steps.notice: The full-width veil is off in all three. The session pill, message box and chips keep the soft surfaces you already chose. These are workbench candidates, not a shipped change.
steps.risk: A still picture can show the surface, not how its hover or press feels. We'll check those on your chosen version.

variants.label: Soft cushion
variants.summary: A soft translucent centre with a shaded lower edge. Gentle depth; the button shape stays visible.

variants.label: Frosted lens
variants.summary: More blur and a thin rim. Clearest glass read, but closest to a conventional little panel.

variants.label: Melted edge
variants.summary: A clearer centre with a brighter upper edge and deeper lower shadow. More raised, less frosted.
